formation.title: Partner training
formation.intro: Six short modules to present IASHARK in your own style, on the right formats, and by the rules. About 20 minutes in total.

modules.title: Pick your angle to match your personality
modules.intro: Videos that work look like the person who makes them. Pick ONE angle and keep it for 4 weeks.
points: The stats fan: you show the screen, read out the calculated chance and the best odds, and explain in one sentence.
The pre-match mate: on camera, relaxed, “look what the app says for tonight”.
The low-key one: no face. Screen recording, on-screen text and your voice (or music).
The teacher: you explain what a calculated chance, odds and a gap are. People save this kind of video.

modules.title: Formats that work
modules.intro: One video, shot once, posted on three networks. Then a short message on Telegram.
points: TikTok: 15 to 25 seconds, vertical, phone in hand, subtitles, a hook in the first 2 seconds.
Instagram Reels: the same video, clearly readable on-screen text, plus a story with the link.
YouTube Shorts: a clear title, for example “Tonight, Arsenal v Chelsea: what the numbers say”.
Telegram: a short message before the day’s matches, with your link and the free IASHARK channel.

modules.title: Hooks
modules.intro: The first 2 seconds decide everything. Show the screen or the match straight away, not your intro.
points: Tonight’s match: “Tonight, Liverpool v Spurs. Look what the numbers say.”
The question: “Still comparing odds by hand?”
Straight to the screen: start on the match page, finger on the calculated chance.
Never say: “easy money”, “100% sure”, “I win every day”. It’s false and it’s forbidden.

modules.title: Your posting schedule
modules.intro: Consistency beats perfection: 3 to 5 videos a week, always at the same times.
points: On match days, post between 12 and 1 pm or between 5 and 7 pm, before kick-off.
Tuesday or Wednesday: a European cup match. Friday: the weekend schedule.
Saturday and Sunday: the match of the day, as a short video and then on Telegram.
Once a week: a teaching video (how to read a calculated chance).

modules.title: Talking about IASHARK honestly
modules.intro: You are presenting a tool, not selling a dream. That is what makes your video credible.
points: What it is: for every match, a chance calculated by a statistical model, the best odds, and the daily schedule on Telegram.
The offer: a 7-day free trial on the monthly plan, then the subscription if you keep it.
What it is not: not a bookmaker, not a guarantee, not staking advice. An estimate is still an estimate.
Say “look what the app says”, never “I won thanks to…”. No results, no amounts, no made-up track record.

modules.title: Mandatory rules
modules.intro: These rules are not up for debate. A single breach ends the partnership.
points: “Paid partnership” written on the video AND in the caption, plus the network’s “branded content” tool where it exists.
18+: adults only. Never a minor on screen, never content aimed at minors.
No promise of winnings, no amounts, no screenshots of winnings, no figure that doesn’t come from IASHARK.
No fake testimonials: you never pretend to be a customer. An AI-created avatar always carries “Virtual image”.
Never a betting operator that isn’t licensed in your country, on screen or as a link.

plan.title: Your personal plan
plan.intro: You don’t have to invent everything alone. Based on your partner questionnaire, we prepare a plan made for you.
points: Your angle, chosen from your personality, your main network and the time you have.
Three formats to shoot first, with the script for each video.
Your 4-week calendar, matched to your country’s fixtures and your language.
Ten ready-to-say hooks, already checked against the rules.
plan.note: Your plan appears in your partner area as soon as it’s ready. If your answers change (new network, less time), fill in the questionnaire again: the plan follows.

kit.title: Partner kit
kit.intro: Everything you need to post today: logos, visuals, ready-to-copy hooks and links.
kit.logos_text: Keep the logo readable on a dark background. Don’t stretch it or change its colours.
kit.visuals_text: Stadium backgrounds with no club logo or recognisable player: use them behind your text or screenshot.
kit.hooks_text: Replace what’s in brackets. Always add the disclosure at the end of the caption.
hooks: Tonight, [team A] v [team B]: look what the numbers say.
Still comparing odds by hand? Look at this.
For every match: the calculated chance and the best odds, in one place.
The daily schedule lands on Telegram. The channel is free.
7-day free trial on the monthly plan. Here’s what you get.
How to read a calculated chance, in 20 seconds.
kit.caption_suffix_label: Disclosure to add to every caption
kit.link_personal: Your personal link (with your code) is in your partner area: use it everywhere instead of the website link.
rules: “Paid partnership” on the video and in the caption.
No promise of winnings, no amounts, no screenshots of winnings.
No fake testimonials. An AI avatar carries “Virtual image”.
No betting operator that isn’t licensed in your country.

avis_pro.title: Your review of IASHARK
avis_pro.intro: You’ve been a subscriber for over a week: what rating would you give IASHARK?
avis_pro.comment_label: One sentence to explain your rating (optional)
avis_pro.comment_placeholder: What helps you most, what’s missing…
avis_pro.privacy: Your rating counts towards the average shown on the site once there are 20 reviews. Your name never appears.
avis_pro.thanks: Thanks, your rating has been saved.
